source.from: EmailSum (Zhang et al., 2021): thread shape (3–10 mails) and short summaries keeping key facts; structure only

request: Summarize my thread with Sofia about the committee.

mails.subject: Committee meeting
mails.body:
Daniel,

The thesis committee meeting is moved to Thursday 3 December, 10:00, room A010. Could you send your reports on the two candidates by Tuesday 1 December?

Sofia

mails.subject: Re: Committee meeting
mails.body:
Sofia,

Noted. By the way, how was the conference in Lisbon? I heard the keynote was great.

Daniel

mails.subject: Re: Committee meeting
mails.body:
Daniel,

Lisbon was lovely, thanks! One more thing: the dean will attend the committee, so please bring printed copies of the reports.

Sofia

mails.subject: Draft chapter 3
mails.body:
Dear Professor Whitmore,

Please find my chapter 3 draft in the shared folder.

Best regards,
Tom
